values.title: Sessions
values.summary: How access and refresh tokens work, and how to end sessions safely.
values.body:
## Tokens

Signing in returns a short-lived access token (15 minutes) and a long-lived refresh token (30 days). The SDK refreshes the access token for you.

## Reading the session

```
const session = await auth.session()
session?.expiresAt // Date
```

## Signing out

`auth.signOut()` revokes the refresh token for the current device. Pass `{ everywhere: true }` to end every session for the user.

Rotate on sensitive changes

Revoke all sessions when a user changes their password or email address.
